title: AG60004: Tractor Systems Design Ii
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Design of tractor chassis. Tractor stability analysis. Single and three point
hitch systems. Drawbar performance. Quick attaching couplers. Hydraulic
controls and systems. Design of mechanical and power steering. Human factors
